decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric is close to the firm's core knowledge, so in-house R&D lets it interpret results and refine the product, although its website presence dropped from its own page to a mention.
The semi-transparent bouclé-effect decoration fabric fits the firm's established design expertise and has stayed steadily on the website, so the firm can assimilate feedback and keep developing it.
The flame-retardant jacquard curtain fabric builds on the firm's functional-fabric competence for contract markets and has kept a page of its own, which points to strong commitment.
The double-face wool-blend fabric extends existing knowledge and fits the shift toward renewable materials, giving the firm a good basis to learn from it.
The wool bouclé leno fabric combines familiar weaving and design competences with natural fibres, so it suits both the firm's absorptive capacity and its sustainability direction.
The braided-structure fabric is a recent launch that builds on established know-how and is featured on a page of its own, so the firm is likely to keep refining it.
